name: Joseph Cordero
profile: High school Junior with a passionate interest in science engineering and interest in pursuing a career in STEM, specifically aerospace engineering. Research experience includes participation in science fair competitions developing individual projects from concept, to experimentation, to fabrication. Provide leadership and collaboration in multiple clubs and in a range of projects and environments.

experience.title: Massachusetts Science & Engineering Fair (MSEF)
experience.summary: Continuing the development of a nitinol shape-memory deployment system to increase the reflective efficiency of solar sails.
accomplishments: Engineer prototypes that are used in experimental and performance testing
Model theoretical behaviors of satellite designs in space environment
Integrate control, deployment, and structural systems within the rigorous constraints of a small scale, CubeSat satellite
Collaborate with advisor and partners to accomplish project goals
Document experiments, design iterations, and project decisions according to stringent competition guidelines.

experience.title: Massachusetts Science & Engineering Fair (MSEF)
experience.summary: Designed improvements to the reflective efficiency of solar sails using a nitinol shape-memory membrane to control sail flatness. Perseverance in Scientific Inquiry award recipient at the Worcester Regional Science and Engineering Fair.
accomplishments: Researched theoretical behaviors of solar sails and existing models to determine areas of improvement and criteria for success.
Quantified engineering constraints and model performance behavior using mathematical modeling
Constructed models that developed different potential sail designs using a variation in structure.
Performed experiments that isolated design elements and determined best performance among a range of potential models.
Communicated findings and progress at local, regional, and state level science fair competitions

experience.title: Massachusetts Science & Engineering Fair (MSEF)
experience.summary: Produced a novel, low-cost, easy-to-use bacterial detection system for use in identifying the contamination of water samples. First Place Grafton High School Science Fair.
accomplishments: Invented an effective solution to address real-world issues pertaining to bacterial water safety.
Designed experiments that determined the behaviors of bacterial dyes and buoyancy agents using limited research materials.
Cultivated lactobacillus samples in accordance with research timelines and experimental demands.
Presented design at local, regional, and state level science competitions.

extracurriculars.name: President Grafton High School (GHS) Debate Club
